title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Ruling regarding my son in case of divorce with my husband 3067 views Q. In a marriage contract of a couple, it is written "The wife is permitted to divorce her husband". 1898 views Q. I was married on Feb 16,2003 and came back to Arab for job to-date I did not go to India due to my job and passport problem. Allah bless us baby boy on Dec 20,2003. In Feb 2004, I lost the job and my inlaws started blaming me that I am married in Saudia. I sent to my wife money several times till June 2004 but after that she refused to take money, the reason was wrong concept of my marriage. After that she left the town and settled in Delhi without my consent and started Diploma in Beauty Parlor course. She came back again to home town in her mother home in July 2005, then I sent her money but she again refused. In Dec 2005, she left to Pakistan without my consent and came back after several months. In July 2006 she called me very nicely I pardoned her and we started talking till Aug 26, 2006. On Sept 13, 2006, She left to Africa along with my three old son without informing me. Her African uncle promised me to send wife/ son to me. She talked nicely from Nov 7 to Dec 2 2006. And suddenly she filed a in Jamiat Ulema Africa for Khula. The main point the wife raised that I am not in touch with her for three years and neither send her money. (Is her maintenace claim valid if she is running here/there in different countries without informing me). They are denying any conversation between Nov 7,2006 to Dec 24,2006 by saying that the voice can be developed on computer in fraud way. The last money I sent her on Aug 6, 2005 because after that she refused to accept. She want to keep son with her. My question is that on this ground our nikah will remain valid or it will finish. I want my wife and son with me as per Quran/ Sunnah. 1954 views Q. Do uttering the word Talaq thrice at one go can be considered talaq in the light of Quaran and Hadidh? 2867 views Q. Khula 2249 views Q. I am Asghar and I got married 2 years back and I have a daughter who is one year old now. My wife has applied for Khula (divorce) in local Jamat (Mosque) 1820 views Q. Marriage (Divorce) Part 2 continued with previous fatwa ID is: 32328 for Marriage (Divorce)1 2115 views Q. ASLK ,My brother divorced his wife some 2 years ago because his Wife Committed a Zina (illicit relationship. The local Kazi issued a Fatwa stating that husband returns back the meher, gifts and also the ruling said that the elder son who is 8 years old to stay with father and the daughter who is 6 years old to be with mother. But my brother refused this fatwa, but as per shariaah he returned back the meher (land worth around 5 lakhs) but he refused to give his daughter as well the jewel which he gifted to his wife. He said that he will give his jewels to his daugher and also said that he will not allow his daughter to grow in an atmosphere where his wife and her family character , morality is not good and conducive for child's growth. Which i feel he is 100% correct. Could you please advise me on this matter? Allah hafiz 2450 views Q. Whether the khula given by woman in the presence of more than two respectable persons and at the same time the male accepted the talaq. 1862 views Q. divorce 1528 views Q. One of my colleagues was divorced by her husband on paper. He sent the talaqnama through post wherein he had mentioned talaq 3 times 2453 views Q. My wife calls me beta and mera baccha some times. What is the ruling in shariya for this? What I heard is calling one's husband beta or mera baccha is wrong and one has to pay kaffara for that. The same thing holds good for the husband too, if he calls his wife amma. 12975 views Q. My question is regarding talaaq. Does mere utterance of the word talaaq causes divorce or should the husband have an intention of divorce while saying these words because I have heard that if a person jokingly also says "talaaq" then divorce occurs? Also if someone says "talaaq" in his mind but not verbally and in this case he intends for divorce, then does talaaq take place? 11232 views Q. I want to ask that last night I and my wife had fight? I was asking her to keep quite but she was still continuing shouting on me. Then in anger I took Quran in my hand say 1 time talaq and said if for 1 month she do not stay with me as per my wish then I will give her second or final talq Please advice? 2497 views Q. after one talaq was pronounced wife didnot return even after four years, does the marriage still exist 4074 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 41915 Country: India Title: I said once to my wife (when we were married newly) that you are like my mother, just as I got 2nd mother Question: I said once to my wife (when we were married newly) that you are like my mother, just as I got 2nd mother. I told so to her by my intention as she loves me and helps me as my mother. It was not my intention that she is having my mother's place. My intention was mother is mother and wife is wife. I told her that she is like my mother because I want to say her that she is loving and helping me as mother. (Now we are having 3 children). Is this a sub? Should I need to give kaffarah? Please guide me. Answer ID: 41915 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1521/975/L=1433) If you intended while pronouncing the sentence “you are like my mother” that she loves and helps you like your mother and you did not intend ‘talaq’ or ‘zihar’ by this sentence then it will not have any effect on your nikah and you will not have to pay any kaffarah. وإن نوى بأنت على مثل أمي أو كأمى ... براً او ظهاراً أو طلاقاً صحت نيته ووقع ما نواه لأنه كناية والا ينو شيئاً أو حذف الكاف لغا وتعين الأدنى أى البر يعنى الكرامة (الدر المختار مع الشامى : 5/131) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
